question: What posthumous honor is granted to a constant rudrākṣa-wearer despite sinful deeds?
premises: The subject may be a doer of sinful deeds.
The subject is characterized as constant in wearing.
The subject is honored in the world of Rudra.
inference: Even a sinful doer who always wears rudrākṣa is honored in Rudra's world.
plain_english: Even one who does sinful deeds, if he always wears it, is honored in the world of Rudra.
